title: Arkansas man loses challenge to sale of ex-wife's share of their jointly owned land
summary_full: A couple bought land together in Arkansas in 2021 but divorced within a year, retaining equal ownership. After the woman filed for bankruptcy in 2023, a trustee sold her share to an investment company. Her former husband challenged the sale, but the US Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit dismissed his appeal because he had not challenged the buyer's good faith before the bankruptcy court.
